map.账务（凭证/账簿/报表）编制 使用指南: Bookkeeping (Vouchers / Ledgers / Statements) Preparation User Guide
map.辅助完成记账凭证、账簿登记与财务报表的编制流程，自动汇总科目余额与试算平衡，适用: Assists the whole flow of preparing bookkeeping vouchers, registering ledgers and producing financial statements, automatically totalling account balances and the trial balance. It suits small business bookkeeping, agency bookkeeping and period-end closing.
map.小微企业或个体工商户用模板完成记账凭证、登记账簿到出具报表的月末结账。: Small businesses and sole traders use the templates to complete month-end closing from bookkeeping vouchers and ledger registration through to the statements.
map.代理记账人员批量处理多家客户的凭证录入与试算平衡。: Agency bookkeepers process voucher entry and the trial balance for many clients in bulk.
map.财务初学者练习从原始凭证到三大报表的完整核算流程。: For finance beginners, practise the full accounting flow from original vouchers through to the three main statements.
map.完成一笔销售业务的账务流转: The accounting flow of one sales transaction
map.：取得销售发票与出库单后，编制记账凭证：借 银行存款/应收，贷 主营业务收入、应: After getting the sales invoice and the outbound note, prepare the bookkeeping voucher: debit bank deposits / accounts receivable, credit main business income and taxes payable; register the subsidiary ledger and the general ledger, carry forward the profit and loss at period end, produce the balance sheet and the income statement and check the trial balance.
map.由三因子求净资产收益率: Return on Equity from Three Factors
map.凭证、账簿、报表之间的逻辑关系？: What is the logical relationship between vouchers, ledgers and statements?
map.先审核原始凭证，编制记账凭证；再据凭证登记日记账与分类账；期末调账、结账后，依据: First review the original vouchers and prepare the bookkeeping vouchers; then record them in the journal and the ledgers; after the period-end adjustments and closing, prepare the financial statements from the ledger balances and transaction amounts, with each step tying to the next.
map.试算不平衡怎么办？: What if the trial balance does not balance?
map.先检查借贷是否等额、科目是否串户、漏记或重记凭证；可借助余额方向与发生额交叉核对: First check whether debits equal credits, whether the accounts used are mixed up, and whether any voucher was missed or recorded twice; cross-check the balance direction against the transaction amounts, locate the error and only then correct it.
